_about: The government of Hawaii, from the people outward. Every node and link names the provision of law that creates it and quotes its words. build.py checks each quote against the provision's text; anything that does not match is marked verified=0. The 19 state departments and their heads are read from HRS 26-4..26-21 automatically; the 15 federal executive departments from 5 U.S.C. 101.
